name: Momentum Consistency-Guided Densification
definition: A densification scheme that uses kinematic phase-space trajectories (momentum) to guide primitive growth, aiming to overcome floating artifacts in non-manifold regions caused by single-step gradient snapshots.
summary: Momentum Consistency-Guided Densification is a 3D Gaussian Splatting optimization that reduces floating artifacts by evaluating gradient consistency against historical momentum trends rather than relying solely on instantaneous gradient magnitude.
